tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background on marketing pages; card, input and dialog fill. Every text token reads on it.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: App page background behind white cards; secondary panels. slate, ink and link read on it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and sidebar surface. In light it equals canvas; in dark it lifts one step above mist.

tokens.name: plaster
tokens.usage: Section band that breaks white rhythm on marketing pages. ink and slate (5.0:1) read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines, the dark button fill. 16:1 on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Logo badge, app-icon tile, dark feature panels. The same in both themes: on the dark canvas give a night panel a bone border.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Nav labels, ghost-button text, strong secondary text, on canvas, mist and card.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, meta. 5.9:1 on canvas, 5.0:1 on plaster (light); 7.3:1 on card (dark).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, disabled labels. 4.5:1 on canvas only: never on mist or plaster in light.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and select borders. 3.4:1 on canvas so a field is always visible.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Disabled borders, body text on the night panel (7.9:1 on night).

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dashed dividers, table rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Default border: cards, ghost buttons, tags, the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: mercury
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav, ghost and neutral items; neutral pill background (carbon text on it).

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Brand lime: logo, badge bars, primary button fill, highlight words on dark. A fill colour: always with ink or night text (13.2:1 and 15.5:1). Never text or a thin shape on white (1.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: End of the logo gradient; pressed state of the primary button. Fill only.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button in light (ink text 10.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Olive: links and brand-coloured text on light surfaces (6.3:1 on canvas, 6.0:1 on brand-50). In dark it is brand lime (15.5:1 on canvas). Components use link.

tokens.name: brand-800
tokens.usage: Text on brand-100 (8.0:1 in light, 9.4:1 in dark, where it is a lighter lime).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill in both themes: brand lime with dark text. On white the fill has no visible edge, so the label and the focus ring carry the button.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: 13.2:1 (light), 15.5:1 (dark). Never white on lime.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and brand-coloured text on canvas, mist, card and brand-50, in both themes: olive on light, lime on dark.

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind olive text: active nav pill, active tag, current-user avatar. link reads on it.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Border of tinted blocks; the focus halo around inputs. brand-800 reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Ink on light surfaces (16:1 on canvas), brand lime on dark (15.5:1). Lime alone would not show on white. The ring is drawn 2px away from the control, so it never touches a primary fill: in dark, lime ring and lime button are separated by the page colour, and this pair is not a text-on-background pairing.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Compliant, declared, paid. Text and dot on success-soft (4.6:1 light, 9.4:1 dark). Always with a word and a check icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success pills and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: To check, near a threshold. Text on warning-soft (5.8:1 light). Amber-brown so it never reads as brand lime.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning pills and of the estimate notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, missing, overdue, destructive actions. Text on danger-soft (5.6:1 light, 7.6:1 dark) and on canvas.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger pills, error alerts, danger-button hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, in progress. The only blue in the system. Text on info-soft (5.1:1 light).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info pills and notices.

families.display: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero only. One per page.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Marketing section openers, big stat numbers.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Marketing sections, dark feature cards, stat numbers in the app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags, nav pills. The smallest Plus Jakarta size.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Enter the address as it appears on the licence.
styles.usage: Body copy, inputs (16px avoids zoom on iPhone).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, table cells, secondary copy, the estimate notice.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status pills, timestamps, footnotes. Never smaller.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase meta labels above a number. Only place with positive tracking.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: References: licence number, booking ID; uppercase.

spacing.note: 4px grid. In Tailwind the default scale is the same grid (p-1 = 4px, p-7 = 28px).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside tight groups; nav pill padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default element gap; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; input padding; card padding under 640px is 20.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; ghost-button padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Primary-button horizontal padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between app sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Dark card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Large gaps in onboarding.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Dark feature card vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Marketing hero padding.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Gap between marketing sections.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Top of the marketing hero on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, badges, status pills, nav pills, avatars. The signature shape.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, alerts, the estimate notice.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Product screenshots and images.

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Dark feature cards and large panels.

tokens.name: shadow-subtle
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on a mist page. The only card shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Product screenshots and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Halo around a focused input, with a focus-coloured border.
